entities.summary: Levan Georgievich Moseshvili was a Georgian basketball player. Playing for the Soviet team he won a silver medal at the 1964 Summer Olympics. Between 1972 and 1998 he was the head coach of Dynamo Tbilisi and after that headed the Georgian team.
